title_en: Geometry-Aware Neural Optimizer for Shape Optimization and Inversion
title_zh: 用于形状优化与反演的几何感知神经优化器

sentences.en: Geometry is central to PDE-governed systems, motivating shape optimization and inversion.
sentences.zh: 几何是PDE支配系统的核心，这推动了形状优化与反演。

sentences.en: Classical pipelines conduct costly forward simulation with geometry processing, requiring substantial expert effort.
sentences.zh: 经典流水线将代价高昂的正向仿真与几何处理相结合，需要大量的专家投入。

sentences.en: Neural surrogates accelerate forward analysis but do not close the loop because gradients from objectives to geometry are often unavailable.
sentences.zh: 神经替代模型加速了正向分析，但并未闭环，因为从目标到几何的梯度往往不可得。

sentences.en: Existing differentiable methods either rely on restrictive parameterizations or unstable latent optimization driven by scalar objectives, limiting interpretability and part-wise control.
sentences.zh: 现有的可微方法要么依赖限制性的参数化，要么依赖由标量目标驱动的、不稳定的潜在优化，限制了可解释性和逐部件控制。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we propose Geometry-Aware Neural Optimizer (\textbf{\textsc{GANO}}), an end-to-end differentiable framework that unifies geometry representation, field-level prediction, and automated optimization/inversion in a single latent-space loop.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了几何感知神经优化器（\textbf{\textsc{GANO}}），一个统一的端到端可微框架，它在单一潜空间循环中统一了几何表示、场级预测和自动优化/反演。

sentences.en: \textsc{GANO} encodes shapes with an auto-decoder and stabilizes latent updates via a denoising mechanism, and a geometry-informed surrogate provides a reliable gradient pathway for geometry updates.
sentences.zh: \textsc{GANO}用自解码器编码形状，并通过去噪机制稳定潜在更新，且一个几何知情的替代模型为几何更新提供了可靠的梯度途径。

sentences.en: Moreover, \textsc{GANO} supports part-wise control through null-space projection and uses remeshing-free projection to accelerate geometry processing.
sentences.zh: 此外，\textsc{GANO}通过零空间投影支持逐部件控制，并使用免重网格化投影来加速几何处理。

sentences.en: We further prove that denoising induces an implicit Jacobian regularization that reduces decoder sensitivity, yielding controlled deformations.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步证明，去噪会引发一种隐式Jacobian正则化，降低解码器敏感性，从而产生受控的变形。

sentences.en: Experiments on three benchmarks spanning 2D Helmholtz, 2D airfoil, and 3D vehicles show state-of-the-art accuracy and stable, controllable updates, achieving up to +55.9% lift-to-drag improvement for airfoils and ~7% drag reduction for vehicles.
sentences.zh: 在覆盖2D Helmholtz、2D翼型和3D车辆三个基准上的实验表明，我们取得了最先进的准确率以及稳定、可控的更新，翼型的升阻比最高提升+55.9%，车辆的阻力降低约7%。

title_en: Geometry-Aware Probabilistic Circuits via Voronoi Tessellations
title_zh: 通过 Voronoi 剖分构建几何感知概率电路

sentences.en: Probabilistic circuits (PCs) enable exact and tractable inference but employ data independent mixture weights that limit their ability to capture local geometry of the data manifold.
sentences.zh: 概率电路（PC）能够进行精确且可处理的推断，但采用与数据无关的混合权重，这限制了它们捕捉数据流形局部几何的能力。

sentences.en: We propose Voronoi tessellations (VT) as a natural way to incorporate geometric structure directly into the sum nodes of a PC.
sentences.zh: 我们提出将Voronoi细分（VT）视为将几何结构直接融入PC求和节点的自然方式。

sentences.en: However, naïvely introducing such structure breaks tractability.
sentences.zh: 然而，天真地引入这种结构会破坏可处理性。

sentences.en: We formalize this incompatibility and  develop two complementary solutions: (1) an approximate inference framework that provides guaranteed lower and upper bounds for inference, and (2) a structural condition for VT under which exact tractable inference is recovered.
sentences.zh: 我们形式化了这种不相容性，并开发了两种互补的解决方案：（1）一个为推断提供保证下界和上界的近似推断框架，以及（2）一种VT下的结构条件，在该条件下可恢复精确的可处理推断。

sentences.en: Finally, we introduce a differentiable relaxation for VT that enables gradient-based learning and empirically validate the resulting approach on standard density estimation tasks.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们为VT引入了一个可微松弛，使基于梯度的学习成为可能，并在标准密度估计任务上实证验证了所得到的方法。

title_en: Geometry-Aware Tabular Diffusion
title_zh: 几何感知表格扩散

sentences.en: Tabular synthesis is critical for privacy-preserving sharing and augmentation, yet diffusion models rely on implicit mechanisms to capture inter-column relationships.
sentences.zh: 表格合成对于隐私保护的共享和增广至关重要，然而扩散模型依赖隐式机制来捕捉列间关系。

sentences.en: We introduce Geometry-Aware Tabular Diffusion (GATD), which augments tabular diffusion denoisers with pairwise angles and lengths computed from column value differences and used as inputs and auxiliary targets.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了几何感知表格扩散（GATD），它用根据列值差异计算出的成对角度和长度来增广表格扩散去噪器，并将它们用作输入和辅助目标。

sentences.en: Our MLP instantiation achieves state-of-the-art benchmark performance while using $3.5\times$ fewer parameters on average (up to $25\times$ for classification tasks): on ten datasets, it wins 8/10 Shape, 7/10 Trend, and 9/10 downstream utility (F1/RMSE), reducing Shape and Trend error by 27\% and 20\%.
sentences.zh: 我们的MLP实例在平均使用$3.5\times$更少参数（分类任务最多$25\times$）的情况下，实现了最先进的基准性能：在十个数据集上，它赢得了8/10的Shape、7/10的Trend和9/10的下游效用（F1/RMSE），并将Shape和Trend误差分别降低了27\%和20\%。

sentences.en: Default loss weights transfer to GNN and Transformer denoisers, improving Shape on 27/30 and Trend on 25/30 architecture-dataset cells.
sentences.zh: 默认损失权重可迁移到GNN和Transformer去噪器，在27/30和25/30个架构-数据集单元格上分别改善了Shape和Trend。

sentences.en: A matched ablation shows supervision (not extra inputs or capacity) drives the gain.
sentences.zh: 一项匹配的消融表明，驱动增益的是监督（而非额外输入或容量）。

sentences.en: This shows explicit relational supervision is a portable inductive bias for tabular diffusion.
sentences.zh: 这表明显式的关系监督是表格扩散的一种可迁移归纳偏置。

title_en: Geometry-based Schrödinger Bridges for Trustworthy Multimodal Fusion
title_zh: 用于可信多模态融合的基于几何的薛定谔桥

sentences.en: Real-world multimodal systems must be robust against low-quality data, such as sensor noise, incomplete multimodal data and conflicting inputs.
sentences.zh: 真实世界的多模态系统必须对低质量数据具有鲁棒性，例如传感器噪声、不完整的多模态数据和相互冲突的输入。

sentences.en: However, existing trustworthy fusion methods rely on the model's own prediction confidence to judge data quality.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的可信融合方法依赖模型自身的预测置信度来判断数据质量。

sentences.en: This creates a circular dependency: when a model is confident but wrong (overconfident), these methods fail to detect the error.
sentences.zh: 这造成了一种循环依赖：当模型自信但错误（过度自信）时，这些方法无法检测到错误。

sentences.en: To break this loop, we propose Geometry-based Multimodal Fusion (GMF).
sentences.zh: 为了打破这一循环，我们提出了基于几何的多模态融合（GMF）。

sentences.en: Instead of relying on predictions, we evaluate reliability by measuring the physical effort required to map input data back to the valid data manifold.
sentences.zh: 我们不依赖预测，而是通过衡量将输入数据映射回有效数据流形所需的物理努力来评估可靠性。

sentences.en: We implement this using Diffusion Schrödinger Bridges with Rectified Flow, which allows us to calculate Transport Energy as a direct metric for quality.
sentences.zh: 我们使用带矫正流的扩散薛定谔桥来实现这一点，它使我们能够将传输能量（Transport Energy）计算为质量的一种直接度量。

sentences.en: The logic is simple: valid data sits on the manifold (low energy), while noisy, incomplete data or conflicting data requires high energy to be restored.
sentences.zh: 逻辑很简单：有效数据位于流形上（低能量），而噪声数据、不完整数据或冲突数据则需要高能量才能被恢复。

sentences.en: This geometric metric acts as an independent judge, effectively flagging unreliable inputs even when the classifier is fooled.
sentences.zh: 这一几何度量充当一个独立的评判者，即使分类器被欺骗，也能有效标记不可靠的输入。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that GMF significantly improves robustness against severe sensor noise and semantic conflicts compared to confidence-based baselines.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，与基于置信度的基线相比，GMF显著提升了对严重传感器噪声和语义冲突的鲁棒性。

title_en: Geometry-Correct Diffusion Posterior Sampling with Denoiser-Pullback Curvature Guidance and Manifold-Aligned Damping
title_zh: 结合去噪器拉回曲率引导与流形对齐阻尼的几何正确扩散后验采样

sentences.en: Diffusion posterior sampling conditions diffusion priors on measurements, but data-consistency updates are typically scaled by hand-tuned guidance weights and can destabilize sampling under stiff, operator-dependent curvature.
sentences.zh: 扩散后验采样以测量为条件作用于扩散先验，但数据一致性更新通常由手工调校的引导权重进行缩放，并且在刚性、依赖算子的曲率下可能使采样不稳定。

sentences.en: We replace scalar guidance with a per-noise-level damped Gauss--Newton correction computed in diffusion-state coordinates.
sentences.zh: 我们用扩散状态坐标中计算的逐噪声级阻尼Gauss-Newton修正来取代标量引导。

sentences.en: The correction pulls likelihood gradients back through the denoiser, uses a one-sided curvature model that avoids forward denoiser Jacobians, and applies diffusion-calibrated rank-one damping aligned with the denoiser residual.
sentences.zh: 该修正将似然梯度通过去噪器回拉，使用避免前向去噪器Jacobian的单侧曲率模型，并应用与去噪器残差对齐的扩散校准秩一阻尼。

sentences.en: Each correction is solved with matrix-free GMRES using automatic differentiation, and sampling proceeds with a variance-preserving Langevin transition with a closed-form drift/noise split.
sentences.zh: 每次修正都用自动微分的无矩阵GMRES求解，采样则采用具有闭式漂移/噪声分离的方差保持Langevin转移进行。

sentences.en: On FFHQ and ImageNet across inverse problems, it achieves competitive PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS while running markedly faster than most of the compared baselines; on accelerated MRI reconstruction, it achieves the best PSNR/SSIM among the compared baselines.
sentences.zh: 在跨逆问题的FFHQ和ImageNet上，它实现了有竞争力的PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS，同时运行速度显著快于大多数被比较的基线；在加速MRI重建上，它在被比较的基线中取得了最好的PSNR/SSIM。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/Seunghyeok0715/CLAMP
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/Seunghyeok0715/CLAMP 获取。

title_en: Geometry-Guided Generative Representation for Functional Brain Graphs
title_zh: 功能脑图的几何引导生成式表征

sentences.en: In network neuroscience, functional brain systems are often characterized using separate yet related graph-theoretic or spectral descriptors, overlooking how these properties covary and partially overlap across individuals and conditions.
sentences.zh: 在网络神经科学中，功能性大脑系统通常通过分离但又相关的图论或谱描述符来刻画，而忽略了这些属性在个体和条件下的共变与部分重叠方式。

sentences.en: We anticipate that dense, weighted functional connectivity graphs lie on a low-dimensional latent geometry along which both topological and spectral structures vary smoothly at the population level.
sentences.zh: 我们预期，密实的加权功能性连接图位于一个低维潜在几何上，在该几何上，拓扑和谱结构在群体层面平滑变化。

sentences.en: Although graph-based deep learning offers a powerful framework for modeling these brain connectomes, supervised approaches are constrained by the limited availability of labeled data.
sentences.zh: 虽然基于图的深度学习为对这些大脑连接组进行建模提供了强大框架，但监督方法受限于标记数据的有限可用性。

sentences.en: Existing unsupervised graph representation methods also typically focus on node-level embeddings, which are limited in capturing compact graph-level representations that preserve information from dense functional connectomes.
sentences.zh: 现有的无监督图表示方法也通常聚焦于节点级嵌入，这在捕捉保留密集功能性连接组信息的紧凑图级表示方面能力有限。

sentences.en: To address these gaps, we learn compact brain graph representations using a graph transformer autoencoder, where domain-specific, aligned functional gradient geometry provides an inductive bias to guide learning.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这些空白，我们使用图transformer自动编码器学习紧凑的大脑图表示，其中领域特定的、对齐的功能梯度几何提供了引导学习的归纳偏置。

sentences.en: Despite being trained in a fully unsupervised manner, our approach meaningfully separates cognitive states and enables decoding of visual stimuli, with performance further improved by incorporating neural dynamics.
sentences.zh: 尽管以完全无监督的方式训练，我们的方法能有意义地区分认知状态，并支持对视觉刺激的解码，且通过融入神经动力学性能进一步提升。

sentences.en: In parallel, to enable generation of synthetic brain graphs, we fit a diffusion model to the learned latent representation and decode samples back to dense connectomes.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，为了能够生成合成的大脑图，我们为学习到的潜在表示拟合一个扩散模型，并将样本解码回密集的连接组。

title_en: Geometry-Guided Modeling of Foundation Features Enables Generalizable Object Shape Deformation Learning
title_zh: 通过几何引导的基础特征建模实现可泛化的物体形状形变学习

sentences.en: Monocular 3D shape recovery is fundamental to geometric understanding, yet achieving robust generalization across arbitrary viewpoints and unseen object categories remains a significant challenge.
sentences.zh: 单目3D形状恢复是几何理解的基础，然而在任意视点和未见物体类别上实现稳健泛化仍然是一个重大挑战。

sentences.en: In this paper, we present a generalizable deformation learning framework that reconstructs 3D objects by explicitly deforming a category-level shape template to match the target observation.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了一个可泛化的形变学习框架，它通过显式地将物体类别的形状模板变形以匹配目标观测，来重建3D物体。

sentences.en: To address complex shape variations between the template and the target, we introduce a geometry-guided feature modeling mechanism.
sentences.zh: 为了解决模板与目标之间复杂的形状变化，我们引入了一种几何引导的特征建模机制。

sentences.en: This process first enriches foundation features with template topology to yield a geometry-aware representation, which is then explicitly correlated with the target observation to guide precise deformation.
sentences.zh: 该过程首先用模板拓扑丰富基础特征，以产生几何感知的表示，然后将其与目标观测显式关联，以引导精确的形变。

sentences.en: Furthermore, to bridge the disparity between the fixed template and arbitrary target views, we propose a view-adaptive feature aggregation module.
sentences.zh: 此外，为了弥合固定模板与任意目标视图之间的差异，我们提出了一个视图自适应特征聚合模块。

sentences.en: This module leverages multi-view template features and their corresponding camera poses to enrich the canonical template representation, ensuring robust feature alignment regardless of the target's perspective.
sentences.zh: 该模块利用多视图模板特征及其对应的相机位姿来丰富规范模板表示，确保无论目标视角如何都能实现稳健的特征对齐。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in handling large shape variations and diverse viewpoints, exhibiting strong generalization to novel categories and effectively supporting downstream real-world dexterous robotic manipulation tasks.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，我们的方法在处理大形状变化和多样视点方面显著优于最先进的方法，对新颖类别展现出很强的泛化能力，并能有效支持下游的真实世界灵巧机器人操作任务。

title_en: Geometry-Misalignment in Distributional Learning
title_zh: 分布学习中的几何失配

sentences.en: Distributional learning problems optimize discrepancies between probability measures, including optimal transport or Sinkhorn divergence, yet are typically optimized using Euclidean first-order methods in parameter space.
sentences.zh: 分布学习问题优化概率测度之间的差异，包括最优传输或Sinkhorn散度，然而它们通常在参数空间中用欧氏一阶方法进行优化。

sentences.en: We show this mismatch is structural rather than algorithmic.
sentences.zh: 我们表明这种错配是结构性的，而非算法性的。

sentences.en: We introduce geometry-misalignment, a local condition number that measures distortion between Euclidean geometry and the intrinsic geometry induced by a distributional objective.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了几何错配，一个衡量欧氏几何与由分布目标所诱导的内在几何之间失真的局部条件数。

sentences.en: For a broad class of problems, we establish lower bounds demonstrating that Euclidean first-order methods incur an unavoidable convergence slowdown proportional to misalignment, even under intrinsic strong convexity and smoothness.
sentences.zh: 对于广泛的一类问题，我们建立了下界，证明即使在内在强凸性和光滑性下，欧氏一阶方法也会遭遇与错配成比例的、不可避免的收敛放缓。

sentences.en: We further prove geometry-aware preconditioned methods attain matching upper bounds independent of misalignment, yielding a sharp separation between Euclidean optimization and geometry-aware optimization.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步证明，几何感知的预条件方法能够达到与错配无关的匹配上界，从而在欧氏优化与几何感知优化之间产生鲜明的分离。

sentences.en: Beyond convergence rates, we show geometry-misalignment induces an optimization-dependent excess risk term under finite budgets, directly linking optimization geometry with statistical efficiency.
sentences.zh: 除了收敛速率之外，我们还表明，几何错配会在有限预算下引入一个与优化相关的超额风险项，直接将优化几何与统计效率联系起来。

sentences.en: We develop a geometry-calibrated optimization framework that estimates misalignment and selectively activates geometry-aware updates when necessary.
sentences.zh: 我们开发了一个几何校准的优化框架，它估计错配，并在必要时选择性地激活几何感知更新。

sentences.en: Experiments on distribution matching for domain adaptation validate the theory, with improvements concentrated in high-misalignment regimes and negligible overhead.
sentences.zh: 域适配的分布匹配实验验证了该理论，改进集中在高错配机制中，且开销可忽略不计。

title_en: Geometry-Preserving Orthonormal Initialization for Low-Rank Adaptation in RLVR
title_zh: 可验证奖励强化学习中低秩适配的几何保持标准正交初始化

sentences.en: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) and its variants enable parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large language models under the supervised fine-tuning (SFT) paradigm.
sentences.zh: 低秩自适应（LoRA）及其变体使得在监督微调（SFT）范式下对大语言模型进行参数高效微调成为可能。

sentences.en: However, their efficacy and behavior under Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) are less well understood.
sentences.zh: 然而，它们在带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）下的有效性和行为还不那么为人所理解。

sentences.en: In particular, two structurally initialized LoRA variants, PiSSA and MiLoRA, which outperform standard LoRA under SFT, can underperform standard LoRA under RLVR and may even exhibit training instability.
sentences.zh: 特别是，两个结构性初始化的LoRA变体PiSSA和MiLoRA，它们在SFT下优于标准LoRA，但在RLVR下可能表现不如标准LoRA，甚至可能表现出训练不稳定性。

sentences.en: These observations suggest that how to initialize the low-rank matrices in RLVR remains unclear.
sentences.zh: 这些观察表明，在RLVR中如何初始化低秩矩阵仍不清楚。

sentences.en: In this work, we develop a theoretical analysis of LoRA in RLVR, showing that orthonormal initialization achieves the minimal gap between LoRA’s outcome and that of full fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们对RLVR中的LoRA进行了理论分析，表明正交初始化在LoRA的结果与完全微调的结果之间实现了最小的差距。

sentences.en: Guided by this insight, we propose geometry-preserving orthonormal initialization for low-rank adaptation in RLVR, leading to two new variants, LoRA-RLPO and LoRA-RLMO.
sentences.zh: 在这一洞见的指导下，我们为RLVR中的低秩自适应提出了保几何的正交初始化，从而产生了两个新变体LoRA-RLPO和LoRA-RLMO。

sentences.en: Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that our orthonormal initialization stabilizes RLVR training and outperforms standard LoRA, contrasting with PiSSA and MiLoRA.
sentences.zh: 在数学推理基准上的实验表明，我们的正交初始化稳定了RLVR训练，并优于标准LoRA，这与PiSSA和MiLoRA形成对比。

sentences.en: Finally, our unified analysis also explains why PiSSA and MiLoRA can underperform in RLVR, which may be of independent interest.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们的统一分析还解释了PiSSA和MiLoRA为何在RLVR中表现不佳，这可能具有独立的意义。

title_en: Geometry-Preserving Unsupervised Alignment for Heterogeneous Foundation Models
title_zh: 异质基础模型的几何保持无监督对齐

sentences.en: Foundation models have driven rapid progress in computer vision, yet the two dominant paradigms, vision-language foundation models (VLMs) and vision-only foundation models (VFMs), remain only partially compatible.
sentences.zh: 基础模型推动了计算机视觉的快速进步，然而两大主导范式，即视觉语言基础模型（VLM）和纯视觉基础模型（VFM），仍然仅部分兼容。

sentences.en: VLMs offer language-grounded semantic alignment but are often visually coarse, while VFMs learn discriminative perceptual geometry but lack semantic grounding.
sentences.zh: VLM提供了基于语言的语义对齐，但往往视觉上粗糙，而VFM学习判别性的感知几何，但缺乏语义接地。

sentences.en: We propose **GPUA**, a *Geometry-Preserving Unsupervised Alignment* framework that integrates the complementary strengths of VFMs and VLMs.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了**GPUA**，一个*保几何无监督对齐*框架，它整合了VFM和VLM的互补优势。

sentences.en: Inspired by cross-lingual alignment, **GPUA** treats VFM features as a *visual language* and learns an *orthogonal* mapping that translates the VFM space into the VLM semantic space, preserving geometry and narrowing the modality gap without labels or model parameter updates.
sentences.zh: 受跨语言对齐的启发，**GPUA**将VFM特征视为一种*视觉语言*，并学习一个*正交*映射，将VFM空间翻译到VLM语义空间，在无需标签或模型参数更新的情况下保留几何并缩小模态差距。

sentences.en: **GPUA** is task-agnostic and requires only feature-level access to pretrained models.
sentences.zh: **GPUA**是任务无关的，并且仅需对预训练模型的特征级访问。

sentences.en: Experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate improved cross-model compatibility and strong gains in downstream zero-shot recognition and segmentation with negligible overhead.
sentences.zh: 跨多个基准的实验表明，跨模型兼容性有所改善，并且在下游零样本识别和分割上取得了强力收益，开销可忽略不计。

sentences.en: Our code is available at: https://github.com/Yuteam14/GPUA.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码见：https://github.com/Yuteam14/GPUA。

authors.name: Huafeng Li
authors.institution: Kunmimg University of Science and Technology

title_en: GeoMoLa: Geometry-Aware Motion Latents for Learning Robust Manipulation Policies
title_zh: GeoMoLa：利用几何感知运动潜在表示学习鲁棒操作策略

sentences.en: Learning motion latents for robotic manipulation heavily relies on extracting motion patterns from visual sequences, yet effective action abstractions require understanding three-dimensional geometric transformations.
sentences.zh: 为机器人操纵学习运动潜变量高度依赖从视觉序列中提取运动模式，然而有效的动作抽象需要理解三维几何变换。

sentences.en: Here, we introduce GeoMoLa (Geometry-Aware Motion Latents), which learns discrete motion latent codes by predicting how point clouds evolve during manipulation rather than reconstructing visual observations.
sentences.zh: 在这里，我们引入了GeoMoLa（几何感知运动潜变量），它通过预测操作过程中点云如何演化来学习离散的运动潜编码，而非重建视觉观测。

sentences.en: This four-dimensional objective – spatial geometry changing through time – forces latent representations to encode actual physical motion rather than appearance patterns.
sentences.zh: 这个四维目标——空间几何随时间变化——迫使潜表示编码真实的物理运动，而非外观模式。

sentences.en: GeoMoLa achieves state-of-the-art performance using only single-view RGB-D input, while existing methods require multi-view reconstruction, succeeding across diverse manipulation benchmarks.
sentences.zh: GeoMoLa仅使用单视图RGB-D输入就取得了最先进的性能，而现有方法需要多视图重建，并在多样的操纵基准上取得成功。

sentences.en: Our ablations reveal that geometric prediction is the key to driving performance, quantitatively validating that manipulation depends on spatial understanding.
sentences.zh: 我们的消融研究揭示，几何预测是驱动性能的关键，定量验证了操纵依赖于空间理解。

sentences.en: Furthermore, the learned codes exhibit effective motion abstraction: applying them to novel scenes produces physically consistent transformations regardless of visual context.
sentences.zh: 此外，学习到的编码展现出有效的运动抽象：将它们应用于新场景会产生物理一致的变换，无论视觉上下文如何。

sentences.en: Our real-world experiments also confirm this robustness capability, achieving robust manipulation with minimal demonstrations in cluttered environments where geometric reasoning determines success.
sentences.zh: 我们的真实世界实验也证实了这一鲁棒性能力，在由几何推理决定成败的杂乱环境中，以极少的演示实现了稳健操纵。

sentences.en: Thus, we demonstrate that effective motion latents for robot control can better emerge from understanding motion through its three-dimensional effects rather than pixel-level patterns.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们证明，用于机器人控制的有效运动潜变量更能从理解运动的三维效应而非像素级模式中涌现。

title_en: GeoPT: Scaling Physics Simulation via Lifted Geometric Pre-Training
title_zh: GeoPT：通过提升式几何预训练扩展物理仿真

sentences.en: Neural simulators promise efficient surrogates for physics simulation, but scaling them is bottlenecked by the prohibitive cost of generating high-fidelity training data.
sentences.zh: 神经仿真器有望成为物理仿真的高效替代品，但受限于生成高保真训练数据的高昂成本，它们的扩展受阻。

sentences.en: Pre-training on abundant off-the-shelf geometries offers a natural alternative, yet faces a fundamental gap: supervision on static geometry alone ignores dynamics and can lead to negative transfer on physics tasks.
sentences.zh: 在充足的现成几何体上进行预训练提供了一种自然的替代方案，但面临一个根本性的差距：仅针对静态几何的监督忽略了动力学，并可能导致物理任务上的负迁移。

sentences.en: We present GeoPT, a unified pre-trained model for general physics simulation based on lifted geometric pre-training.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了GeoPT，一个基于抬升几何预训练的通用物理仿真统一预训练模型。

sentences.en: The core idea is to augment geometry with synthetic dynamics, enabling dynamics-aware self-supervision without physics labels.
sentences.zh: 核心思想是用合成动力学增广几何，从而实现无需物理标签的动力学感知自监督。

sentences.en: Pre-trained on over one million samples, GeoPT consistently improves industrial-fidelity benchmarks spanning fluid mechanics for cars, aircraft, and ships, and solid mechanics in crash simulation, reducing labeled data requirements by 20-60% and accelerating convergence by 2$\times$.
sentences.zh: 在超过一百万个样本上预训练后，GeoPT持续改进覆盖汽车、飞机和船舶流体力学以及碰撞仿真中固体力学的工业级保真度基准，将标注数据需求降低了20-60%，并将收敛加速了2$\times$。

sentences.en: These results show that lifting with synthetic dynamics bridges the geometry-physics gap, unlocking a scalable path for neural simulation and potentially beyond.
sentences.zh: 这些结果表明，用合成动力学进行抬升弥合了几何-物理差距，为神经仿真乃至更广泛的领域开辟了一条可扩展的路径。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/Physics-Scaling/GeoPT.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/Physics-Scaling/GeoPT 获取。

title_en: GeoReward: Mitigating Contextual Variable Overestimation in Vision-Language Models for Cross-Market Preference Prediction
title_zh: GeoReward：缓解视觉语言模型中的上下文变量高估，以预测跨市场偏好

sentences.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) excel in many multimodal tasks but remain prone to a subtle yet impactful failure mode: they tend to overestimate dominant visual-textual cues while underestimating sparse but decision-critical contextual variables.
sentences.zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在许多多模态任务中表现出色，但仍易受一种微妙而影响深远的失败模式的影响：它们倾向于高估占主导的视觉文本线索，同时低估稀疏但决策关键的上下文变量。

sentences.en: This issue, which we term Contextual Variable Overestimation (CVE), becomes particularly evident in real-world applications such as predicting advertisement image preferences across diverse geographic markets.
sentences.zh: 我们将这一问题称为上下文变量高估（CVE），它在诸如预测跨不同地理市场的广告图像偏好等真实世界应用中变得尤为明显。

sentences.en: For instance, when a VLM (e.g., Qwen2-VL) is asked to choose between two product images tailored for different countries (e.g., Korea vs. France), it often defaults to a consistent output (e.g., always selects “A”), ignoring ground-truth regional variations.
sentences.zh: 例如，当要求一个VLM（如Qwen2-VL）在两个面向不同国家（如韩国与法国）定制的产品图像之间做出选择时，它往往会默认为一致输出（如始终选择“A”），而忽略真实的区域变化。

sentences.en: This collapse occurs because pervasive high-volume signals, such as product attributes and dense image patches, overwhelm the few but critical tokens that encode market-specific context (e.g., country names).
sentences.zh: 这种坍缩的发生是因为普遍存在的高容量信号，如产品属性和密集图像块，压倒了为数不多但编码市场特定上下文（如国家名称）的关键词元。

sentences.en: To address CVE, we first collect a new multimodal dataset of real advertising creatives and their click-through performance across multiple countries.
sentences.zh: 为了解决CVE，我们首先收集了一个新的多模态数据集，包含真实的广告创意及其在多个国家的点击表现。

sentences.en: We then introduce GeoReward, a reward model designed to predict ad image preferences across diverse geographic markets.
sentences.zh: 随后我们介绍了GeoReward，一个旨在预测跨不同地理市场的广告图像偏好的奖励模型。

sentences.en: GeoReward integrates three purpose-built mechanisms: (1) Market-Aware Retrieval Augmentation, which retrieves and injects region-aligned preference signals during training to sharpen localization awareness.
sentences.zh: GeoReward整合了三种专门构建的机制：（1）市场感知检索增强，它在训练期间检索并注入区域对齐的偏好信号，以增强区域定位意识。

sentences.en: (2) Context-Guided Visual Modulation, a lightweight adapter that dynamically adjusts visual representations using textual country embeddings, enabling fine-grained regional adaptation.
sentences.zh: （2）上下文引导的视觉调制，一个轻量级适配器，它使用文本国家嵌入动态调整视觉表示，实现细粒度的区域适配。

sentences.en: (3) Selective Sensitivity Loss, an objective that applies heightened penalties for context-specific mispredictions, sharpening the model's focus on critical variables.
sentences.zh: （3）选择性敏感性损失，一个对特定上下文错误预测施加更高惩罚的目标，强化模型对关键变量的关注。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we demonstrate how GeoReward can guide the fine-tuning of RL for a VLM to generate background designs for text-to-image models (e.g., SDXL), producing market-aware advertising creatives.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们展示了GeoReward如何引导VLM的强化学习微调，以为文本到图像模型（如SDXL）生成背景设计，产生市场感知的广告创意。

sentences.en: Experiments validate that our framework mitigates CVE and outperforms existing baselines.
sentences.zh: 实验验证了我们的框架缓解了CVE，并优于现有基线。

sentences.en: This work not only diagnoses a systematic bias in VLMs toward dominant perceptual features but also delivers a targeted solution for applications where sparse contextual variables govern decision-making.
sentences.zh: 这项工作不仅诊断了VLM中朝向主导感知特征的系统性偏置，还为稀疏上下文变量主导决策的应用提供了有针对性的解决方案。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/liushuo-hue/GeoReward.git.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/liushuo-hue/GeoReward.git 获取。

title_en: GeoSense: Internalizing Geometric Necessity Perception for Multimodal Reasoning
title_zh: GeoSense：为多模态推理内化几何必然性感知

sentences.en: Advancing towards artificial superintelligence requires rich and intelligent perceptual capabilities.
sentences.zh: 迈向超级智能需要丰富而聪慧的感知能力。

sentences.en: A critical frontier in this pursuit is overcoming the limited spatial understanding of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), where geometry information is essential.
sentences.zh: 这一追求中的一个关键前沿，是克服多模态大语言模型（MLLM）有限的空间理解，而几何信息在其中至关重要。

sentences.en: Existing methods often address this by rigidly injecting geometric signals into every input, while ignoring their necessity and adding computation overhead.
sentences.zh: 现有方法往往通过将几何信号硬性地注入每个输入来解决这个问题，而忽略了它们的必要性，并增加了计算开销。

sentences.en: Contrary to this paradigm, our framework endows the model with an awareness of perceptual insufficiency, empowering it to autonomously engage geometric features in reasoning when 2D cues are deemed insufficient.
sentences.zh: 与这一范式相反，我们的框架赋予模型对感知不足的觉察，使其能够在2D线索被认为不足时，自主地在推理中调用几何特征。

sentences.en: To achieve this, we first introduce an independent geometry input channel to the model architecture and conduct alignment training, enabling the effective utilization of geometric features.
sentences.zh: 为了实现这一点，我们首先为模型架构引入一个独立的几何输入通道，并进行对齐训练，从而能够有效利用几何特征。

sentences.en: Subsequently, to endow the model with perceptual awareness, we curate a dedicated spatial-aware supervised fine-tuning dataset.
sentences.zh: 随后，为了赋予模型感知觉察，我们整理了一个专门的空间感知监督微调数据集。

sentences.en: This serves to activate the model’s latent internal cues, empowering it to autonomously determine the necessity of geometric information.
sentences.zh: 这用于激活模型的潜在内在线索，使其能够自主决定几何信息的必要性。

sentences.en: Experiments across multiple spatial reasoning benchmarks validate this approach, demonstrating significant spatial gains without compromising 2D visual reasoning capabilities, offering a path toward more robust, efficient and self-aware multi-modal intelligence.
sentences.zh: 跨多个空间推理基准的实验验证了这种方法，展示了在没有损害2D视觉推理能力的显著空间增益，为更稳健、高效且自我感知的多模态智能提供了一条路径。

authors.name: Haihong Hao
authors.institution: University of Science and Technology of China

title_en: GePBench: Evaluating Fundamental Geometric Perception for Multimodal Large Language Models
title_zh: GePBench：评估多模态大语言模型的基础几何感知

sentences.en: Geometric shapes play important roles in both physical world and human cognition.
sentences.zh: 几何形状在物质世界和人类认知中都扮演着重要角色。

sentences.en: While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made significant advancements in visual understanding, their abilities to recognize geometric shapes and their spatial relationships, which we term geometric perception, are not explicitly and systematically explored.
sentences.zh: 虽然多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在视觉理解方面取得了重大进展，但它们在识别几何形状及其空间关系方面的能力（我们称之为几何感知）尚未被显式且系统地进行探索。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we introduce GePBench, a novel benchmark specifically designed to assess the geometric perception capabilities of MLLMs.
sentences.zh: 为了填补这一空白，我们引入了GePBench，一个专门用于评估MLLM几何感知能力的新颖基准。

sentences.en: Our extensive evaluations reveal that even the current state-of-the-art MLLMs exhibit significant deficiencies in geometric perception tasks.
sentences.zh: 我们的大量评估揭示，即使是最先进的MLLM，在几何感知任务上也表现出显著的不足。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we show that models trained with GePBench data demonstrate considerable improvements on a wide range of downstream tasks, highlighting the critical role of geometric perception in enabling advanced multimodal applications.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们表明，使用GePBench数据训练的模型在一系列广泛的下游任务上表现出可观的改进，凸显了几何感知在实现先进多模态应用中的关键作用。

sentences.en: Our code and datasets are available at https://github.com/Changhao-Xiang/GePBench.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码和数据集可在 https://github.com/Changhao-Xiang/GePBench 获取。

title_en: GEPC: Group-Equivariant Posterior Consistency for Out-of-Distribution Detection in Diffusion Models
title_zh: GEPC：通过群等变后验一致性实现扩散模型分布外检测

sentences.en: Diffusion models learn a time-indexed score field $\mathbf{s}_\theta(\mathbf{x}_t,t)$ that often inherits approximate equivariances (flips, rotations, circular shifts) from in-distribution (ID) data and convolutional backbones.
sentences.zh: 扩散模型学习一个时间索引的分数场 $\mathbf{s}_\theta(\mathbf{x}_t,t)$，它常常从分布内（ID）数据和卷积主干中继承近似等变性（翻转、旋转、循环平移）。

sentences.en: Most diffusion-based out-of-distribution (OOD) detectors exploit score magnitude or local geometry (energies, curvature, covariance spectra) and largely ignore equivariances.
sentences.zh: 大多数基于扩散的分布外（OOD）检测器利用分数幅度或局部几何（能量、曲率、协方差谱），并在很大程度上忽略了等变性。

sentences.en: We introduce Group-Equivariant Posterior Consistency (GEPC), a training-free probe that measures how consistently the learned score transforms under a finite group $G$, detecting equivariance breaking even when score magnitude remains unchanged.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了群等变后验一致性（GEPC），一种免训练的探针，它衡量学习到的分数在有限群 $G$ 下变换的一致程度，即使在分数幅度不变的情况下也能检测到等变性破缺。

sentences.en: At the population level, we propose the ideal GEPC residual which averages an equivariance-residual functional over $G$, and we derive ID upper bounds and OOD lower bounds under mild assumptions.
sentences.zh: 在群体层面，我们提出了理想的GEPC残差，它在 $G$ 上平均一个等变性残差泛函，并在温和假设下推导出ID上界和OOD下界。

sentences.en: GEPC requires only score evaluations and produces interpretable equivariance-breaking maps.
sentences.zh: GEPC仅需分数评估，并产生可解释的等变性破缺图。

sentences.en: On OOD image benchmark datasets, we show that GEPC achieves competitive or improved AUROC compared to recent diffusion-based baselines while remaining computationally lightweight.
sentences.zh: 在OOD图像基准数据集上，我们表明，与近期基于扩散的基线相比，GEPC实现了有竞争力或更优的AUROC，同时保持计算轻量。

sentences.en: On high-resolution synthetic aperture radar imagery where OOD corresponds to targets or anomalies in clutter, GEPC yields strong target-background separation and visually interpretable equivariance-breaking maps.
sentences.zh: 在高分辨率合成孔径雷达图像上（其中OOD对应杂波中的目标或异常），GEPC产生了强烈的目标-背景分离和视觉上可解释的等变性破缺图。

sentences.en: The official implementation is available at https://github.com/RouzAY/gepc-diffusion/.
sentences.zh: 官方实现可在 https://github.com/RouzAY/gepc-diffusion/ 获取。

topic: General Machine Learning->Transfer, Multitask and Meta-learning
title_en: GFedCL: Graph-Based Federated Continual Learning with Spatial and Temporal Awareness
title_zh: GFedCL：具有时空感知能力的基于图的联邦持续学习

sentences.en: Recent years have witnessed a surge of interest in federated learning.
sentences.zh: 近年来，人们对联邦学习的兴趣激增。

sentences.en: In particular, federated continual learning (FCL) emerged as an effective approach that enables clients with evolving, non-storable data to engage in collective learning.
sentences.zh: 特别是，联邦持续学习（FCL）作为一种有效方法脱颖而出，它使得拥有不断演化、不可存储数据的客户端能够参与集体学习。

sentences.en: Among FCL approaches, replay-based methods excel by mitigating data storage constraints through synthetic data generation.
sentences.zh: 在FCL方法中，基于重放的方法通过合成数据生成来缓解数据存储约束，表现尤为突出。

sentences.en: However, existing replay-based methods overlook spatial and temporal information inherent in FCL settings, leading to suboptimal model performance.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的基于重放的方法忽视了FCL设置中固有的空间和时间信息，导致模型性能次优。

sentences.en: For instance, spatial variation in COVID-19 prevalence across hospitals in different states (e.g., Delta surging in Florida vs. Omicron in New York) and the temporal evolution of regional outbreaks are critical information for accurately distinguishing between COVID variants.
sentences.zh: 例如，不同州医院间COVID-19流行率的空间差异（如Delta在佛罗里达州激增，而Omicron在纽约流行）以及区域疫情的时间演化，是准确区分COVID变体的关键信息。

sentences.en: This paper presents GFedCL to address this limitation.
sentences.zh: 本文提出了GFedCL来弥补这一局限。

sentences.en: GFedCL is a new FCL approach that (1) constructs spatial- and temporal-aware relational graphs with attention mechanisms, and (2) uses the graphs, combined with generative adversarial learning, to generate high-quality synthetic data.
sentences.zh: GFedCL是一种新的FCL方法，它（1）用注意力机制构建空间和时间感知的关系图，并且（2）将该图与生成对抗学习相结合，以生成高质量的合成数据。

sentences.en: GFedCL can generate synthetic data that matches the expectation of real data distribution while preserving privacy with theoretical guarantees.
sentences.zh: GFedCL能够在以理论保证保护隐私的同时，生成与真实数据分布期望相匹配的合成数据。

sentences.en: GFedCL consistently outperforms state-of-the-art FCL methods, gaining 27.95% improvement on TinyImageNet.
sentences.zh: GFedCL持续优于最先进的FCL方法，在TinyImageNet上取得了27.95%的改进。

authors.name: Qizhen Zhang
authors.institution: Department of Computer Science, University of Toronto

title_en: GFFMERGE: Efficient Merging of Graph Neural Force Fields and Beyond
title_zh: GFFMERGE：高效合并图神经力场及其拓展

sentences.en: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have revolutionized Neural Force Fields for atomistic simulations, achieving near-quantum accuracy at reduced cost, yet adapting these models to new chemical systems requires expensive retraining of foundation models.
sentences.zh: 图神经网络（GNN）已彻底改变了用于原子模拟的神经力场，以降低的成本实现了接近量子级的精度，然而将这些模型适配到新的化学体系需要昂贵的基础模型重新训练。

sentences.en: Inspired by model merging in vision and language processing, we introduce GFFMERGE, the first principled framework for closed-form model merging in GNNs.
sentences.zh: 受视觉和语言处理中模型合并的启发，我们引入了GFFMERGE，第一个面向GNN闭式模型合并的原则性框架。

sentences.en: We exploit the linear structure of message-passing layers and formulate merging as a convex embedding-alignment problem with an analytical solution.
sentences.zh: 我们利用消息传递层的线性结构，将合并表述为一个具有解析解的凸嵌入对齐问题。

sentences.en: Through the first systematic benchmarking of model merging for GNNs, we show that existing methods designed for vision and language catastrophically fail on force field regression, while GFFMERGE recovers performance approaching gold standard joint training.
sentences.zh: 通过首次对GNN模型合并的系统性基准测试，我们表明为视觉和语言设计的现有方法在力场回归上灾难性地失效，而GFFMERGE恢复的性能接近黄金标准的联合训练。

sentences.en: Across molecular (MD17, MD22), solid-state (LiPS20), and large-scale graph benchmarks, GFFMERGE and GNNMERGE (its generic GNN counterpart) achieve 5-27$\times$ speedups while enabling modular composition of specialized models.
sentences.zh: 在分子（MD17、MD22）、固态（LiPS20）和大规模图基准上，GFFMERGE及其通用GNN对应物GNNMERGE实现了5-27$\times$的加速，同时支持专业模型的模块化组合。

sentences.en: Remarkably, our closed-form solution alone outperforms all baseline methods before fine-tuning and provides superior initialization for faster, data-efficient convergence.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，我们仅凭闭式解就在微调前胜过所有基线方法，并为更快、数据高效的收敛提供了更优的初始化。

title_en: GFMate: Empowering Graph Foundation Models with Test-time Prompt Tuning
title_zh: GFMate：通过测试时提示调优增强图基础模型

sentences.en: Graph prompt tuning has shown great potential in graph learning by introducing trainable prompts to enhance the model performance in conventional single-domain scenarios.
sentences.zh: 图提示调优通过引入可训练提示来提升模型在常规单域场景中的性能，在图学习中展现出了巨大的潜力。

sentences.en: Recent research has extended graph prompts to improve Graph Foundation Models (GFMs) by few-shot tuning auxiliary prompts.
sentences.zh: 近期的研究已通过少样本调优辅助提示，将图提示扩展用于改进图基础模型（GFM）。

sentences.en: Despite their progress, most existing methods embed source-domain information into prompts, which serve either as input to GFMs or encoded during model pre-training.
sentences.zh: 尽管取得了进展，多数现有方法将源域信息嵌入到提示中，这些提示要么作为GFM的输入，要么在模型预训练期间被编码。

sentences.en: Such prompt entanglement with specific source domains and GFM pre-training strategy restricts their generalisability to other domains and different GFMs.
sentences.zh: 这种提示与特定源域和GFM预训练策略的纠缠，限制了它们向其他领域和不同GFM的泛化能力。

sentences.en: Furthermore, existing GFM prompts merely rely on few-shot tuning for adaptation, neglecting the rich information in unlabelled target domain test data.
sentences.zh: 此外，现有的GFM提示仅仅依赖少样本调优进行适配，忽视了未标记目标域测试数据中的丰富信息。

sentences.en: Motivated by these insights, this paper aims to empower GFMs with pre-training-agnostic test-time graph prompt tuning, named GFMate.
sentences.zh: 受这些洞见的驱动，本文旨在用预训练无关的测试时图提示调优来赋能GFM，称为GFMate。

sentences.en: GFMate introduces centroid and layer prompts applied after pre-training on target domains, avoiding entanglement with specific source domains and model pre-training.
sentences.zh: GFMate引入在目标域预训练之后应用的质心提示和层级提示，避免了与特定源域和模型预训练的纠缠。

sentences.en: In addition, a test-time complementary learning objective is devised to exploit both labelled and unlabelled target domain data for effective test-time prompt tuning.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们设计了一个测试时互补学习目标，同时利用标记和未标记的目标域数据，以实现有效的测试时提示调优。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on 12 benchmark datasets demonstrate the superior performance and efficiency of GFMate, achieving improvements of up to 30.63%.
sentences.zh: 在12个基准数据集上的大量实验证明了GFMate优越的性能和效率，实现了至多30.63%的改进。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/YanJiangJerry/GFMate.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/YanJiangJerry/GFMate 获取。

title_en: GHOST: Geometry-Guided Hallucination of Opaque Surface Textures
title_zh: GHOST：几何引导的不透明表面纹理补想

sentences.en: Transparent objects pose a fundamental challenge for depth estimation and 3D reconstruction due to their violation of Lambertian assumptions, leading to severe geometry degradation in downstream tasks.
sentences.zh: 透明物体由于违反Lambertian假设，对深度估计和3D重建构成了根本性挑战，导致下游任务中出现严重的几何退化。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose a novel geometry-guided preprocessing framework GHOST that leverages visual foundation models to transform transparent regions into opaque, structurally consistent representations without requiring downstream model retraining.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新颖的几何引导预处理框架GHOST，它利用视觉基础模型将透明区域转换为不透明的、结构一致的表示，而无需下游模型重训练。

sentences.en: Specifically, our pipeline utilizes (1) TransDINO and (2) TransDecomp to disentangle masks and transparency physical properties, while (3) DAF-Net recovers surface normal priors to encode geometric curvature.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们的流水线利用（1）TransDINO和（2）TransDecomp来解缠掩码与透明度物理属性，而（3）DAF-Net恢复表面法线先验以编码几何曲率。

sentences.en: Subsequently, (4) GeoSemTransNet integrates these multi-modal cues to synthesize a texture-rich opaque RGB image that preserves the transparent object's 3D structure.
sentences.zh: 随后，（4）GeoSemTransNet整合这些多模态线索，合成一个保留透明物体3D结构的、纹理丰富的不透明RGB图像。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly enhances the accuracy of state-of-the-art depth estimation and reconstruction models on transparent objects by restoring essential photometric cues.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，我们的方法通过恢复关键的测光线索，显著提升了最先进的深度估计和重建模型在透明物体上的准确性。

title_en: GHOST: Unmasking Phantom States in Mamba2 via Grouped Hidden-state Output-aware Selection & Truncation
title_zh: GHOST：通过分组隐藏状态输出感知选择与截断揭示 Mamba2 中的幽灵状态

sentences.en: While Mamba2's expanded state dimension enhances temporal modeling, it incurs substantial inference overhead that saturates bandwidth during autoregressive generation.
sentences.zh: 虽然Mamba2扩展的状态维度增强了时间建模，但它也带来了可观的推理开销，在自回归生成期间使带宽趋于饱和。

sentences.en: Standard pruning methods fail to address this bottleneck: unstructured sparsity leaves activations dense, magnitude-based selection ignores runtime dynamics, and gradient-based methods impose prohibitive costs.
sentences.zh: 标准的剪枝方法无法解决这一瓶颈：非结构化稀疏性使激活保持稠密，基于幅度的选择忽略了运行时动力学，而基于梯度的方法则带来高昂的成本。

sentences.en: We introduce GHOST (Grouped Hidden-state Output-aware Selection and Truncation), a structured pruning framework that approximates control-theoretic balanced truncation using only forward-pass statistics.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了GHOST（分组隐状态输出感知选择与截断），一个结构化的剪枝框架，它仅利用前向传播统计量来逼近控制理论中的均衡截断。

sentences.en: By jointly measuring controllability and observability, GHOST rivals the fidelity of gradient-based methods without requiring backpropagation.
sentences.zh: 通过联合度量可控性和可观测性，GHOST在无需反向传播的情况下达到了与基于梯度的方法相当的保真度。

sentences.en: As a highlight, on models ranging from 130M to 2.7B parameters, our approach achieves a 50% state-dimension reduction with approximately 1 perplexity point increase on WikiText-2.
sentences.zh: 作为亮点，在130M到2.7B参数的模型上，我们的方法实现了50%的状态维度缩减，而WikiText-2上的困惑度仅增加约1个点。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/Menezmic21/mamba2_ghost.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/Menezmic21/mamba2_ghost 获取。

title_en: GI-GCN: Global Interacted Graph Convolutional Networks via Dominant Sets for Graph Classification
title_zh: GI-GCN：通过优势集实现全局交互图卷积网络，用于图分类

sentences.en: Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs) are defined based on aggregating the information of adjacent nodes, that are usually treated as equally important and may limit the representational power of existing GCNs.
sentences.zh: 图卷积网络（GCN）基于聚合相邻节点的信息来定义，这些节点通常被视为同等重要，这可能限制了现有GCN的表征能力。

sentences.en: To address this shortcoming, we propose a novel Global Interacted Graph Convolutional Network (GI-GCN), that leverages the solution vectors maintained during the iterative updates of the Dominant Set to adaptively characterize the global importance distribution over all nodes.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这一不足，我们提出了一种新颖的全局交互图卷积网络（GI-GCN），它利用支配集（Dominant Set）迭代更新过程中维护的解向量，自适应地刻画所有节点上的全局重要性分布。

sentences.en: Specifically, at each convolution layer, this distribution is adopted to adaptively modulate the importance weights of node features before performing the local message passing.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，在每一卷积层，该分布在执行局部消息传递之前，被用于自适应地调制节点特征的重要性权重。

sentences.en: We show that this convolution strategy can effectively capture the highly correlated information between nonadjacent nodes through the Dominant Set algorithm, not only emphasizing the critical graph-level information but also enhancing the discriminative power of graph representations.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，这种卷积策略能够通过支配集算法有效捕获非相邻节点之间高度相关的信息，既强调了关键的图级信息，又增强了图表示的判别力。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we optimize the memory complexity of the framework, significantly reducing the memory overhead associated with the global interaction modeling.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们优化了框架的内存复杂度，显著减少了与全局交互建模相关的内存开销。

sentences.en: Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed GI-GCN model.
sentences.zh: 实验证明了所提出的GI-GCN模型的有效性。

title_en: GICDM: Mitigating Hubness for Reliable Distance-Based Generative Model Evaluation
title_zh: GICDM：缓解枢纽效应，实现可靠的基于距离的生成模型评估

sentences.en: Generative model evaluation commonly relies on high-dimensional embedding spaces to compute distances between samples.
sentences.zh: 生成模型评估通常依赖高维嵌入空间来计算样本之间的距离。

sentences.en: We show that dataset representations in these spaces are affected by the hubness phenomenon, which distorts nearest-neighbor relationships and biases distance-based metrics.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，这些空间中数据集表示受到hubness现象的影响，该现象扭曲了最近邻关系并使基于距离的指标产生偏差。

sentences.en: Building on the classical Iterative Contextual Dissimilarity Measure (ICDM), we introduce Generative ICDM (GICDM), a method to correct neighborhood estimation for both real and generated data.
sentences.zh: 在经典迭代上下文相异度度量（ICDM）的基础上，我们提出了生成式ICDM（GICDM），一种针对真实数据和生成数据都进行邻域估计校正的方法。

sentences.en: We introduce a multi-scale extension to improve empirical behavior.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了一个多尺度扩展来改善经验行为。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on synthetic and real benchmarks demonstrate that GICDM resolves hubness-induced failures, restores reliable metric behavior, and improves alignment with human assessment.
sentences.zh: 在合成和真实基准上的大量实验表明，GICDM解决了由hubness引发的失败，恢复了可靠的指标行为，并改善了与人类评估的一致性。

title_en: GIFT: Bootstrapping Image-to-CAD Program Synthesis via Geometric Feedback
title_zh: GIFT：通过几何反馈自举实现图像到 CAD 程序合成

sentences.en: Generating executable CAD programs from images requires alignment between visual geometry and symbolic program representations, a capability that current methods fail to learn reliably as design complexity increases.
sentences.zh: 从图像生成可执行的CAD程序，要求视觉几何与符号程序表示之间的对齐，而这种能力是当前方法在设计复杂性增加时无法可靠学习的。

sentences.en: Existing fine-tuning approaches rely on either limited supervised datasets or expensive post-training pipelines, resulting in brittle systems that restrict progress in generative CAD design.
sentences.zh: 现有的微调方法要么依赖有限的监督数据集，要么依赖昂贵的后训练流水线，导致系统脆弱，限制了生成式CAD设计的进展。

sentences.en: We argue that the primary bottleneck lies not in model or algorithmic capacity, but in the scarcity of diverse training examples that align visual geometry with program syntax.
sentences.zh: 我们认为主要瓶颈不在于模型或算法能力，而在于将视觉几何与程序语法对齐的多样化训练示例的稀缺。

sentences.en: This limitation is especially acute because the collection of diverse and verified engineering datasets is both expensive and difficult to scale, constraining the development of robust generative CAD models.
sentences.zh: 这一局限尤为严重，因为收集多样且经过验证的工程数据集既昂贵又难以扩展，制约了稳健生成式CAD模型的开发。

sentences.en: We introduce Geometric Inference Feedback Tuning (GIFT), a data augmentation framework that leverages geometric feedback to turn test-time compute into a bootstrapped set of high-quality training samples.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了几何推理反馈调优（GIFT），一种数据增广框架，它利用几何反馈将测试时计算转化为自举的高质量训练样本集。

sentences.en: GIFT combines two mechanisms: Soft-Rejection Sampling (GIFT-REJECT), which retains diverse high-fidelity programs beyond exact ground-truth matches, and Failure-Driven Augmentation (GIFT-FAIL), which converts near-miss predictions into synthetic training examples that improve robustness on challenging geometries.
sentences.zh: GIFT结合了两种机制：软拒绝采样（GIFT-REJECT），它保留超过精确真实匹配的多样化高保真程序，以及失败驱动增广（GIFT-FAIL），它将近乎命中的预测转换为合成训练示例，以改进在挑战性几何上的鲁棒性。

sentences.en: By amortizing inference-time search into the model parameters, GIFT captures the benefits of test-time scaling while reducing inference compute by 80%.
sentences.zh: 通过将推断时搜索摊销进模型参数，GIFT捕获了测试时扩展的益处，同时将推断计算减少了80%。

sentences.en: It improves mean IoU by 12% over a strong supervised baseline and remains competitive with more complex multimodal systems, without requiring additional human annotation or specialized architectures.
sentences.zh: 它相对于一个强大的监督基线将平均IoU提高了12%，并在不需要额外人工标注或专门架构的情况下，与更复杂的多模态系统保持竞争力。

title_en: GIPO: Gaussian Importance Sampling Policy Optimization
title_zh: GIPO：高斯重要性采样策略优化

sentences.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning (RL) has recently shown strong promise for advancing multimodal agents beyond supervised imitation.
sentences.zh: 用强化学习（RL）进行训练后阶段，近来在将多模态智能体推进到超越监督模仿方面显示出强大的前景。

sentences.en: However, RL remains limited by poor data efficiency, particularly in settings where interaction data are scarce and quickly become outdated.
sentences.zh: 然而，RL仍然受制于差的数据效率，尤其是在交互数据稀缺且很快就会过时的设置中。

sentences.en: To address this challenge, GIPO (Gaussian Importance sampling Policy Optimization) is proposed as a policy optimization objective based on truncated importance sampling, replacing hard clipping with a log-ratio-based Gaussian trust weight to softly damp extreme importance ratios while maintaining non-zero gradients.
sentences.zh: 为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了GIPO（高斯重要性采样策略优化），一个基于截断重要性采样的策略优化目标，它用基于对数比的高斯可信权重取代硬裁剪，从而在保持非零梯度的同时柔和地抑制极端的重要性比率。

sentences.en: Theoretical analysis shows that GIPO introduces an implicit, tunable constraint on the update magnitude, while concentration bounds guarantee robustness and stability under finite-sample estimation.
sentences.zh: 理论分析表明，GIPO对更新幅度引入了一个隐式的、可调约束，而浓度界在有限样本估计下保证了鲁棒性和稳定性。

sentences.en: Experimental results show that GIPO achieves state-of-the-art performance among clipping-based baselines across a wide range of replay buffer sizes, from near on-policy to highly stale data, while exhibiting superior bias--variance trade-off, high training stability and improved sample efficiency.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，在从近似在线到高度过期数据的广泛重放缓冲区大小范围内，GIPO在基于裁剪的基线中取得了最先进的性能，同时展现出更优的偏差-方差权衡、高度的训练稳定性和提高的样本效率。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/distanceLu/GIPO.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/distanceLu/GIPO 获取。

title_en: GIST: Targeted Data Selection for Instruction Tuning via Coupled Optimization Geometry
title_zh: GIST：通过耦合优化几何为指令调优定向选择数据

sentences.en: Targeted data selection has emerged as a crucial paradigm for efficient instruction tuning, aiming to identify a small yet influential subset of training examples for a specific target task.
sentences.zh: 目标数据选择已成为高效指令微调的一个关键范式，旨在为特定目标任务识别一个虽小但有影响力的训练示例子集。

sentences.en: In practice, influence is often measured through the effect of an example on parameter updates.
sentences.zh: 在实践中，影响力往往通过示例对参数更新的效果来衡量。

sentences.en: To make selection scalable, many approaches leverage optimizer statistics (e.g., Adam states) as an axis-aligned surrogate for update geometry (i.e., diagonal precondition), implicitly treating parameters as coordinate-wise independent.
sentences.zh: 为了使得选择可扩展，许多方法利用优化器统计量（如Adam状态）作为更新几何的轴对齐代理（即对角预条件），隐式地将参数视为坐标独立。

sentences.en: We show that this assumption breaks down in parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods such as LoRA.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，这一假设在LoRA等参数高效微调（PEFT）方法中会失效。

sentences.en: In this setting, the induced optimization geometry exhibits strong cross-parameter coupling with non-trivial off-diagonal interactions, while the task-relevant update directions are confined to a low-dimensional subspace.
sentences.zh: 在这种设置下，所诱导的优化几何展现出强跨参数耦合和不可忽略的非对角交互，而与任务相关的更新方向被限制在一个低维子空间中。

sentences.en: Motivated by this mismatch, we propose **GIST** (Gradient Isometric Subspace Transformation), a simple yet principled alternative that replaces axis-aligned scaling with robust subspace alignment.
sentences.zh: 基于这一错配，我们提出了**GIST**（梯度等距子空间变换），一种简单而有原则的替代方案，用稳健的子空间对齐取代轴对齐缩放。

sentences.en: **GIST** recovers a task-specific subspace from validation gradients via singular value decomposition (SVD), projects training gradients into this coupled subspace, and scores examples by their alignment with target directions.
sentences.zh: **GIST**通过奇异值分解（SVD）从验证梯度中恢复一个任务特定子空间，将训练梯度投影进这个耦合子空间，并根据示例与目标方向的对齐程度对其评分。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments have demonstrated that **GIST** matches or outperforms the state-of-the-art baseline with only 0.29% of the storage and 25% of the computational time under the same selection budget.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，在相同的选择预算下，**GIST**仅用0.29%的存储和25%的计算时间就达到或优于最先进的基线。

title_en: Giving Sensors a Voice: Multimodal JEPA for Semantic Time-Series Embeddings
title_zh: 让传感器发声：用于语义时间序列嵌入的多模态 JEPA

sentences.en: Transformer-based architectures have advanced sequence modeling in language and vision, yet general-purpose representation learning for heterogeneous multivariate time series remains underexplored.
sentences.zh: 基于Transformer的架构推进了语言和视觉中的序列建模，然而面向异构多变量时间序列的通用表示学习仍未被充分探索。

sentences.en: We introduce CHARM (Channel-Aware Representation Model), which incorporates channel-level textual descriptions into a Transformer encoder equivariant to channel order.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了CHARM（通道感知表示模型），它将对通道级别的文本描述并入一个对通道顺序等变的Transformer编码器中。

sentences.en: CHARM is trained with a Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) and a novel loss promoting informative, temporally stable embeddings; latent-space prediction encourages robustness to sensor noise while description-aware gating provides interpretability through learned inter-channel relationships.
sentences.zh: CHARM使用联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）和一个促进信息丰富、时间稳定嵌入的新颖损失进行训练；潜在空间预测增强了对传感器噪声的鲁棒性，而描述感知的门控通过学习到的通道间关系提供了可解释性。

sentences.en: Across anomaly detection, classification, and short- and long-term forecasting, the learned embeddings achieve strong performance using only a linear probe.
sentences.zh: 在异常检测、分类以及短期和长期预测中，学习到的嵌入仅用线性探针就取得了强劲的性能。

sentences.en: Performance is driven primarily by the JEPA objective and conditioning architecture, with text descriptions serving as channel identifiers for cross-dataset generalization.
sentences.zh: 性能主要由JEPA目标和条件化架构驱动，文本描述充当跨数据集泛化的通道标识符。

title_en: GKD-Recruiter: Jointly Modeling Social and Task Heterogeneity for Spatial Crowdsourcing via Graph Knowledge Distillation
title_zh: GKD-Recruiter：通过图知识蒸馏联合建模社会与任务异质性，以支持空间众包

sentences.en: Social recruitment offers a solution to worker scarcity in Spatial Crowdsourcing (SC) but faces challenges that are often ignored in traditional Influence Maximization.
sentences.zh: 社交招募为空间众包（SC）中的劳动者短缺提供了一种解决方案，但面临着传统影响力最大化中常被忽略的挑战。

sentences.en: First, task heterogeneity arising from offline execution constraints breaks the interest-implies-participation assumption, as social influence often fails to translate into physical presence.
sentences.zh: 首先，由离线执行约束引起的任务异质性打破了兴趣出勤假设，因为社会影响力往往无法转化为实际到场。

sentences.en: Second, finite task demand creates a saturation trap, a non-submodular setting in which utility drops sharply to zero once demand is met.
sentences.zh: 其次，有限的任务需求造成一个饱和陷阱，这是一种非子模设置，一旦需求被满足，效用就会急剧降为零。

sentences.en: To bridge these gaps, we propose GKD-Recruiter, a Task-Aware framework designed to maximize Effective Task Satisfaction (ETS).
sentences.zh: 为了弥合这些差距，我们提出了GKD-Recruiter，一个以最大化有效任务满意度（ETS）为目标的任务感知框架。

sentences.en: We explicitly model the complex worker-task affinity via a heterogeneous graph and capture directional social influence using a novel Influential GAT.
sentences.zh: 我们通过异质图显式地对复杂的劳动者-任务亲和度进行建模，并使用一种新颖的具备影响力的GAT来捕获方向性的社会影响力。

sentences.en: To robustly fuse these distinct signals, we introduce a Graph Knowledge Distillation mechanism.
sentences.zh: 为了稳健地融合这些不同的信号，我们引入了一种图知识蒸馏机制。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we employ Rainbow DQN to navigate the non-submodular combinatorial search space, avoiding the local optima that trap greedy heuristics.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们采用Rainbow DQN来在非子模的组合搜索空间中导航，避开困住贪心启发式的局部最优。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that GKD-Recruiter significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both solution quality and inference efficiency.
sentences.zh: 在真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明，GKD-Recruiter在解质量和推理效率两方面都显著优于最先进基线。

sentences.en: The code is available at https://github.com/GaoYucen/GKD-Recruiter.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/GaoYucen/GKD-Recruiter 获取。

title_en: GLAD: Bidirectional Structure-Attribute Alignment via Latent Graph Diffusion Models
title_zh: GLAD：通过潜在图扩散模型实现双向结构–属性对齐

sentences.en: Learning on graphs with missing node attributes is a prevalent yet challenging problem in real-world scenarios, as graph neural networks (GNNs) typically rely on complete attribute information.
sentences.zh: 在具有缺失节点属性的图上学习是真实世界场景中一个普遍而具有挑战性的问题，因为图神经网络（GNN）通常依赖完整的属性信息。

sentences.en: Existing solutions often employ adversarial learning in a shared latent space to align graph structure and attributes.
sentences.zh: 现有的解决方案往往在共享潜在空间中采用对抗学习来对齐图结构和属性。

sentences.en: However, these methods frequently suffer from training instability and mode collapse, failing to fully capture the complex, multi-modal joint distribution of topology and features.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些方法常常受困于训练不稳定和模式坍缩，无法充分捕获拓扑与特征的复杂多模态联合分布。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, we present GLAD, a novel generative framework for robust node attribute completion.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这些局限，我们提出了GLAD，一个用于稳健节点属性补全的新颖生成式框架。

sentences.en: GLAD leverages the strong generative capabilities of diffusion models to learn the conditional distribution of attributes given the graph structure within a decoupled latent space.
sentences.zh: GLAD利用扩散模型的强大生成能力，在解耦的潜在空间中学习给定图结构条件下的属性条件分布。

sentences.en: Unlike previous unidirectional approaches, GLAD introduces a robust bidirectional alignment mechanism.
sentences.zh: 与先前的单向方法不同，GLAD引入了一个稳健的双向对齐机制。

sentences.en: Specifically, we incorporate a structure reconstruction constraint during training and structure-aware classifier-free guidance during sampling, ensuring that generated attributes are not only plausible but also maintain strict topological consistency with the underlying graph.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们在训练中融入一个结构重建约束，并在采样中融入结构感知的无分类器引导，确保生成的属性不仅合理，而且与底层图保持严格的拓扑一致性。

sentences.en: Theoretically, we show that GLAD maximizes a tighter variational lower bound on the joint log-likelihood compared to GAN-based predecessors, leading to superior mode coverage.
sentences.zh: 理论上，我们表明，与基于GAN的先驱方法相比，GLAD在联合对数似然上最大化了一个更紧的变分下界，从而带来更优的模式覆盖。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on large-scale benchmarks demonstrate that GLAD significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both attribute recovery quality and downstream task performance.
sentences.zh: 在大规模基准上的大量实验表明，GLAD在属性恢复质量和下游任务性能两方面都显著优于最先进基线。

title_en: GLARE: Scalable Neuro-Symbolic Reward Shaping for LLM Agents via Group-Level Automata
title_zh: GLARE：通过组级自动机为大语言模型智能体实现可扩展神经符号奖励塑形

sentences.en: Reinforcement Learning (RL) with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) shows great promise for enhancing LLM reasoning, but remains challenged by sparse and unstable rewards in long-horizon tasks.
sentences.zh: 使用群体相对策略优化（GRPO）的强化学习（RL）在增强LLM推理方面显示出巨大的前景，但在长时域任务中仍然受困于稀疏而不稳定的奖励。

sentences.en: Existing approaches to reward shaping struggle to balance semantic expressiveness, reliability, and computational efficiency: heuristic rules lack flexibility, while LLM-as-a-Judge incurs high computational cost and suffer from inconsistent and misaligned scoring signals in long-context settings.
sentences.zh: 现有的奖励塑形方法难以在语义表现力、可靠性和计算效率之间取得平衡：启发式规则缺乏灵活性，而LLM作为评判者则带来高昂的计算成本，并在长上下文设置中遭遇不一致且错位的评分信号。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we introduce GLARE, a neuro-symbolic reward framework that decouples semantic abstraction from credit assignment.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这些挑战，我们引入了GLARE，一个将语义抽象与信用分配解耦的神经符号奖励框架。

sentences.en: Specifically, to leverage semantic understanding while preserving symbolic determinism, we first extract and symbolize trajectory events into a discrete representation.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，为了在保留符号确定性的同时利用语义理解，我们首先将轨迹事件提取并符号化到一个离散表示中。

sentences.en: These events are then translated into Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) formulas, which are compiled into deterministic automata that track the agent's progress via state transitions.
sentences.zh: 然后，这些事件被翻译成线性时序逻辑（LTL）公式，这些公式被编译为通过状态转换跟踪智能体进展的确定性自动机。

sentences.en: This mechanism yields dense and consistent reward signals, avoiding unstable direct scoring while significantly reducing computational cost.
sentences.zh: 这一机制产生密集且一致的奖励信号，避免了不稳定的直接评分，同时显著降低了计算成本。

sentences.en: Empirical results on ALFWorld show that GLARE outperforms GRPO by 12.1\% in success rate, while achieving an 8.1\% improvement over conventional LLM-based judges using only 15\% of their computational cost.
sentences.zh: ALFWorld上的实证结果表明，GLARE在成功率上比GRPO高出12.1\%，同时仅用LLM作为评判者15\%的计算成本，就取得了8.1\%的改进。
